insights.one_liner: Insify is an Amsterdam scale-up offering AI-powered insurance for small businesses, backed by EUR 43M; it sponsors visas and its finance role needs no Dutch.

culture.text: A scale-up aiming to become Europe's leader in AI-powered insurance for small and medium businesses.
Its one open job here is a mid-level finance and accounting role in Amsterdam, which drew about 44 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: Insify Holding B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Insify has raised EUR 43 million in total from investors including Accel, Munich Re Ventures and Nico Rosberg.
In five years it expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany.
It launched a car insurance product for entrepreneurs with AI-driven premiums, together with Ominimo.
